key_insight: Collaborating AI agents autonomously derived and experimentally tested a quantum-spin calibration result, rejecting initially favorable evidence when signal drift undermined it.
engineering_relevance: Agent-to-agent review and explicit acceptance criteria offer a practical architecture for autonomous labs that can detect unreliable measurements and revise experiments.
method: Generate and critique research questions, with authority to stop or redirect investigations.
Derive minimum calibration requirements for a defined family of microwave pulse sequences and check them computationally.
Design discriminating experiments on quantum-spin ensembles in diamond and monitor reference measurements.
evidence_signal: Repeated reference measurements exposed drift in the initial experiment; a revised protocol met unchanged acceptance criteria and supported the theoretical predictions.
watch_item: The demonstration concerns a defined quantum-spin setting; reliability and generalization across other experimental domains remain to be established.
paper_title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
